meta.ref: main@e0e3b8b; token sync 2026-10-14 (accepted tokens landed, tone edges, usage strings)

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand mark's own blue: the rounded 'M' square on sign-in screens (Tailwind @theme --color-brand). Deliberately not a Tailwind scale value. Never used for buttons or links.

tokens.name: brand-icon
tokens.usage: The fill of the shipped PWA/favicon PNGs (static/icons). Differs from `brand` (#2f80ff) — a discrepancy in the source, kept as found.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-600. Links, eyebrow labels, the active bottom-bar tab, the current approval step, unread dots, signature handles. White text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-700. Link hover; also the ink of the `info` badge tone.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: The accent at 20% (`ring-accent/20`). The 4px halo around the current step marker in the approval stepper. Follows the accent role, so a Workspace's accent hue moves it (owner decision K-08, 14 Okt 2026: the artifact follows the code; before it, blue-100 / blue-900).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Tailwind blue-300. 2px focus outline, 1px offset, on every interactive element (DS-D14, 12 Okt 2026): links, buttons, summaries and fields.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Theme ink.strong → darkest (slate-900). Titles, figures people scan for, Field values. Also the page's base text colour.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Theme ink.body → dark (slate-700). Text people read or click: menu items, secondary Button label, form labels, comment bodies.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Theme ink.secondary → medium (slate-500). Captions, descriptions, meta lines, table head labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Theme ink.faint → light (slate-400). Hints, placeholders, decoration only. ≈2.6:1 on white — FAILS WCAG AA for real content; the source flags this itself.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Theme background.raised → lightest (white). Cards, panels, sections, the header and bottom bar, Field fill.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Theme background.base → lighter (slate-50). The page canvas behind everything; also table-head bands and inset wells.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Theme background.sunken → light (slate-100). A board lane or recessed well.

tokens.name: border-divider
tokens.usage: Theme border.divider → faint (slate-100). Row separators inside lists and tables.

tokens.name: border-surface
tokens.usage: Theme border.surface → soft (slate-200). Outlines panels, sections, cards, tiles, popovers; rules bounding a region (header, table head, bottom nav); secondary Button outline.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Theme border.control → defined (slate-300). An input/select/textarea's own box; the dashed ring of a pending Avatar.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill (`ink-strong`) with `bg-raised` text. The primary action is near-black, not blue.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: The strong ink at 90% (`bg-ink-strong/90`). Primary Button hover: the near-black fill, slightly lighter over the surface in light mode, slightly dimmer in dark (K-08, 14 Okt 2026; before it, slate-800 / slate-200).

tokens.name: count-badge
tokens.usage: The fill of a count badge that asks for attention: the red number on the notification bell and on the Approval Inbox nav item. The `bad` tone's ink used as a solid fill, with `bg-raised` text (the same on-fill pair as the primary Button). Recorded because the audit found it written four ways with no token (gap plan K-10, 15 Okt 2026); the four hand-drawn badges are not folded into one component yet (an absolutely positioned badge over an icon and an inline one differ in more than colour).

tokens.name: hover-wash

tokens.name: avatar-fill

tokens.name: scrim

tokens.usage: Badge tone `muted`: edge (slate-100 light, slate-800 dark). Since DS-D16 a tone is a triple (fill, ink, edge); a Workspace remapping the tone moves all three.

tokens.name: tone-muted-bg
tokens.usage: Badge tone `muted` → palette grey-faint: fill (slate-50). Absent / not applicable — deliberately distinct from neutral.

tokens.name: tone-muted-ink

tokens.name: mark-good
tokens.usage: Emerald-600. Isi padat penanda selesai: lingkaran ceklis, titik status 'approved', bar kemajuan. DINAMAI DI LUAR SKEMA `tone-*` dengan sengaja — tone adalah pasangan bg/ink yang bisa ditimpa Workspace lewat `theme.tone`, sedangkan ini satu warna isi untuk grafik kecil dan tidak punya pasangan. Menamainya `tone-good-solid` akan menjanjikan mekanisme override yang tidak ada. DITERIMA 7 Okt 2026, menggantikan usulan dua langkah (emerald-500 ditolak: ~2.1:1 di atas putih, gagal 3:1 untuk grafik bermakna / WCAG 1.4.11). Bukti: 83 pemakaian, 2 dari 3 layar audit. Di kode sejak 11–12 Okt 2026: reader markGoodFill/markGoodBorder (internal/rendering/layout.templ), dijaga TestNoHandWrittenMarkGood.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: text.display → huge (text-2xl). A Metric tile's headline number, emphasis weight.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: text.heading → large (text-xl). A screen's own title (<h1>), emphasis weight.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: text.subheading → medium (text-base). One section's title inside a screen.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: text.item → normal-plus (text-item, custom 0.9375rem). One item's title in a list or on a card: an Application, a group, a member, a document card, a settings row. Usually emphasis weight; a settings row draws it at body weight. Owner decision DS-D13, 12 Oct 2026.

styles.name: panel-heading
styles.usage: Body size at emphasis weight — a panel's own title (StaticPanelHeading). Kept separate from subheading pending owner decision D7.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Submit a document and choose who signs it, in order.
styles.usage: text.body → normal (text-sm). Prose, row content, Button and Field text. The most used size (194 sites).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: text.meta → small (text-xs). A date, a count, a project name beside something else.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: text.label → tiny (text-2xs, custom 0.6875rem). Text inside a badge or pill — short, never a sentence.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.

styles.name: auth-subtitle

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 base unit is 0.25rem (4px). Gap and padding are Theme roles; amounts are named in words in Go (two, three…) and map 1:1 to Tailwind steps.

tokens.name: gap-region
tokens.usage: Satu langkah di atas `gap-loose` (gap-6). Memisah region besar dalam satu layar — daftar dari panel samping, header dari isi. DITERIMA 7 Okt 2026: memperpanjang ujung tangga, bukan menyisipkan langkah di tengahnya. Di kode sejak 12 Okt 2026: peran Theme `GapRegion` (gap-6); hanya satu dari tiga situs gap-6 berarti region. Bukti: 3 dari 3 layar audit.

tokens.name: control-height-compact
tokens.usage: Tinggi kontrol kecil: tombol ikon, chip filter, pil yang bisa ditekan di dalam baris. Melengkapi `control-height` 36px dan 42–44px. DITERIMA 7 Okt 2026: kontrol bertingkat (kecil/standar/sentuh) adalah praktik baku. SYARAT: hanya untuk penunjuk presisi (mouse). Di layar sentuh, area tekannya harus tetap 44×44px lewat padding transparan — 32px sendiri melanggar WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size. Di kode sejak 12 Okt 2026: reader `controlHeightCompact()` = `h-8 pointer-coarse:h-11`, jadi syarat sentuh ada di dalam reader. Catatan: di sentuh kontrolnya menjadi 44px yang terlihat, bukan area tekan transparan (rencana perbaikan K-05).

tokens.name: gap-xtight
tokens.usage: Satu langkah di bawah `gap-tight` (gap-1.5). Hanya untuk pasangan ikon/dot dengan labelnya di dalam komponen padat yang lebarnya terkunci — header lane papan, baris kartu, chip status. Bukan untuk jarak antar komponen; di layar yang lapang pakai `gap-tight`. Di kode sejak 11 Okt 2026: peran Theme domain.GapXtight → gap-1.5 (13 situs inline; 9 jarak antar-komponen sengaja tidak).
tokens.evidence: Sempat ditolak dengan alasan 8px sudah cukup. Uji coba 7 Okt 2026 membantahnya: menaikkan 268 titik dari 6px ke 8px membuat judul lane 'Pre-production' dan judul kartu di papan Project Management (lane 182px) pecah ke baris tambahan. 6px memang menanggung beban layout di permukaan padat, jadi token ini diterima dengan ruang lingkup yang jelas.

tokens.name: gap-micro
tokens.usage: Theme gap.micro → one (gap-1). Ujung bawah tangga gap: judul dengan subjudulnya, label dengan nilainya, ikon kecil dengan teksnya. Ditambahkan 12 Okt 2026 (keputusan pemilik G1), memperpanjang ujung bawah tangga seperti gap-region memperpanjang ujung atasnya. Di kode: domain.GapMicro, 79 situs.

tokens.name: gap-hair
tokens.usage: Theme gap.hair → half (gap-0.5). Langkah terkecil: baris teks bertumpuk yang rapat (nama dan email, label dan keterangannya). Ditambahkan 12 Okt 2026 (keputusan pemilik G1). Di kode: domain.GapHair, 31 situs.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Theme radius.control → small (rounded-md). Buttons, Fields, and small tiles inside a surface.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Theme radius.surface → large (rounded-lg). Panels, sections, cards, Metric tiles, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Theme radius.pill → full (rounded-full). StatusBadges, Avatars, step markers.

tokens.name: radius-brand-mark

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the mobile bottom sheet (rounded-t-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: The corner of an element that sits inside a control or a surface with its own corner: the knob of a segmented control inside its 6px track and 2px padding, a small link in a row. Outer radius minus its padding. Owner decision K-11 (14 Okt 2026): recorded as a token because the audit found it on 54 elements in 17 pages; there is no Theme role for it (the corners stay literal, DS-D17).
